title: Alpenglow Capitals LLM integration scout
content:
Context / quick summary:
- Account: Alpenglow Capitals (mid-size asset manager, ~120 employees, offices in NY + London).
- Heard via warm intro from Priya's ex-colleague (Samir Patel). Looking to prototype llm-driven investor Q&A and client reporting summarization. Regulatory sensitivity (SEC/UK FCA) — likely want private deployment or dedicated with strict KMS and audit logs.
- Primary ask so far: standardize and speed up quarterly report summaries and build a searchable call notes assistant for PMs. Secondary: client-facing Q&A chatbot (must pass compliance checks).

Why Redwood fits (hypothesis):
- Need predictable latency + cost for many short queries (embed + retrieval + short generation) -> Redwood Optimize recommendations + batching helps cost.
- Compliance: Private deployment/VPC + KMS options and audit logs (this is a gating factor).
- Rollouts & fallbacks: good for regulated usage where model behavior must be controlled and can degrade gracefully.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdowns and evals for quality regressions -> helpful for compliance sign-off.

Key contacts (to validate):
- Samir Patel (intro) — Head of Platform Engineering (NY) — email: samir.p@alpenglowcap.com (confirm)
- Leah Brooks — Head of Research / PM for automation — likely technical buyer
- Marcus Reed — Chief Compliance Officer — ultimate blocker for private data usage
- Sales/Procurement contact TBD after initial technical thumbs-up

Pain points (from notes + call snippets):
- Current workflows: very manual; analysts spend ~6 hrs/week per PM summarizing notes and reports
- Existing data stack: Snowflake + internal search (Elastic) + homegrown vector store prototype (not prod)
- Slow model experimentation (infra ops overhead) -> they tried a self-hosted small LLM and ops was a nightmare
- Compliance needs audit trails, key custody, and model explainability for client-facing outputs

Initial outreach draft (brief, two-line email for Samir intro):
Subject: quick idea for reducing PM summarization time by 70%
Hi Samir —
Thanks for offering to connect. We help teams like Alpenglow run secure, predictable LLM inference for summaries, retrieval-augmented Q&A, and monitored rollouts. Quick idea: a small pilot (4–6 weeks) to auto-generate investor report summaries + a PM search assistant using your Snowflake data behind a private VPC. No raw data leaves your environment by default.
If that sounds useful I can share a one-pager and a short demo — any interest?
— Sofia

Longer outreach (value + ask):
- Opening paragraph: 2–3 sentences about Redwood + tailored value: predictable token costs, private deployment, KMS, and audit logs.
- Two bullets: concrete pilot scope (ingest last 12 months of reports -> generate 150–200 word summaries; build a retrieval assistant for internal PM notes) + success metrics (reduce PM summarization time by X, <200ms median latency for summary generation for short prompts).
- Close: ask 15–30 minute intro, offer to bring solutions engineer 

Objections & suggested responses:
- "We can't send client data to third parties": Offer private deployment (VPC) or Dedicated with customer-managed keys. Highlight audit logs and on-prem options. Follow-up: propose an architecture doc and SOC2/ISO artifacts and one-pager explaining data flow.
- "Ops overhead is too high": Redwood Dedicated provides reserved capacity + managed autoscaling policies; propose a 6-week managed pilot with SOW that includes runbook handoff.
- "Model hallucinations for client-facing content": Propose retrieval-augmented pipeline + evaluations + continuous quality monitoring; show prior case where we reduced hallucination rate via prompt engineering + grounding and regression alerts.
- "Cost concerns": Run a cost projection for their QPS and token mix; show Optimize config (batching/quantization) that reduces unit cost while meeting latency SLOs.

Technical hooks / architecture to propose (sketch for SE):
1) Ingest pipeline: Snowflake -> ETL to vector store (customers prefer we help with connector config, or they keep vector store in their VPC).
2) Retrieval layer: kNN + metadata filtering (fund-level vs client-level).
3) Redwood inference: dedicated/dedicated-private endpoint running open LLM + quantized weights, prefix caching for recurring queries, latency SLO 150–300ms for short-gen.
4) Observability: per-route dashboards, token breakdowns, quality evals keyed to sample prompt set, audit logs to satisfy compliance.
5) Key management: integrate with AWS KMS / customer HSM.

Pilot scope (recommended): 6 weeks, 2 PMs as users, ingest 300 reports + call notes, deliver
- Search assistant (internal) with 80%+ usefulness metric by PM survey
- Summary generator producing 150–250 word executive summaries
- Weekly quality reviews + regression checks
- Final handoff + runbook
Estimated ask: 1 SE (20% time), 1 integration engineer (50% time) for 6 weeks, small dedicated capacity slot (estimate to size after initial metric collection).

Demo plan (45 minutes total):
- 5m quick intros + context
- 10m show: ingest -> retrieval -> short live query (show embeddings + similarity)
- 10m show: summary generation (live prompt variations) + latency/cost dashboard
- 10m QA: compliance + data flow (bring compliance talking points + architecture slide)
- 10m next steps + pilot sizing discussion

Sample prompts to show in demo: (short, pragmatic)
- "Summarize the Q3 investor memo into a 180-word executive summary focused on performance, risks, and positioning."
- "Given these call notes, what are the top three action items for PM X and suggested timelines?"
- "Answer the client question: 'How did fund Y perform vs benchmark last quarter?' using only the ingested documents; cite sources."

Research questions / TODOs before intro call:
- Confirm Samir's email + Leah's presence on thread (Priya to intro) — action: Priya
- Get quick inventory of their Snowflake size & whether anything sensitive is tokenized — action: discovery checklist (send before demo)
- Prepare short two-page architecture + compliance one-pager (SE + Security) — action: Ethan
- Cost projection template filled with realistic token mix (call with Pricing) — action: Sofia + Pricing
- One-pager showing previous customer anecdote (anonymous) where private deployment + audit logs resolved compliance concerns — action: Solutions content team

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep language non-technical in opening emails — highlight "no raw data leaves your environment" and "audit logs + KMS".
- Emphasize speed: PM time savings as primary ROI; cost savings as secondary.
- Be ready to pivot to dedicated if they balk at private deployment complexity.
- Bring a short checklist for Marcus (compliance) that maps Redwood artifacts to their potential compliance questions (SOC2, encryption at rest/in transit, data residency).

Meeting prep checklist (48h before):
- Confirm intro + attendees (include compliance + infra if possible)
- Share one-pager and demo recording from similar use-case
- Load sample dataset (anonymized) into demo sandbox for live examples
- SE: prepare slide mapping Redwood features to their gating criteria

Next steps (immediate):
- Priya to make intro to Samir + Leah (target Mon 2025-11-17)
- Fill discovery checklist and get Snowflake info before intro (due: Wed 2025-11-19)
- Draft cost projection + pilot SOW template (due: Fri 2025-11-21)

Scratch space / snippets for calls:
- "We can run the first pilot entirely within your VPC and integrate with your KMS — Redwood’s control plane only orchestrates, we can limit any host-level telemetry you don’t want shared."
- "Typical pilot shows 50–80% reduction in time spent on summarization tasks for PMs depending on fidelity requirements."
- Quick ask script: "If we can show a 1–2 week POC that reduces PM time materially, would you consider a 6–12 month engagement?"

End of doc.
